purpose: Choose multiple options from a bounded visible list.
accessibility: The trigger and expanded list communicate selected values.
Multiple selections expose selected state in the listbox.
Escape dismisses the popup without losing committed values.
responsive: Reflows within constrained containers without changing the content contract.
Retains shared control geometry and touch-target minimums.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: options
api.description: Finite choices rendered by the control.

api.name: onValueChange
api.description: Callback fired with the next canonical value.

api.name: label
api.description: Visible or accessible name for the control.

api.name: loading
api.description: Communicates pending options while preserving the trigger.

api.name: error
api.description: Explains an invalid or unavailable selection state.
